privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.section1_text: We collect email address and username during registration. Uploaded files are used only for real-time processing and are not used for any other purpose.
privacy_page.section2_text: All uploaded files are automatically deleted from our servers within 1 hour of processing. We do not store, share, or resell your files.
privacy_page.section3_text: We use WeChat Pay and Alipay to process payments. We do not directly store your credit card or bank account information.
privacy_page.section4_text: We use necessary session cookies to maintain login state. Google AdSense may use third-party cookies.
privacy_page.section5_text: For privacy concerns, please email privacy@watermarkwipe.com.

terms_page.title: Terms of Service
terms_page.section1_text: By using WatermarkWipe, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms_page.section2_text: WatermarkWipe provides online watermark removal tools for images, videos, and PDF processing. We use AI and traditional image processing techniques to remove watermarks. Results may vary depending on the complexity of the watermark and source material.
terms_page.section3_text: You agree to only upload files you have legal rights to process. You must not use WatermarkWipe to remove copyright management information or bypass technical protection measures without authorization.
terms_page.section4_text: Watermark removal results are provided 'as is' without any guarantee of perfection. Complex watermarks, especially those integrated into the image content, may leave traces or artifacts. We do not guarantee 100% perfect removal for all inputs.
terms_page.section5_text: Due to the digital nature of our service, all payments are non-refundable after plan activation. If you experience technical issues preventing service usage, contact support@watermarkwipe.com within 7 days for assistance.
terms_page.section6_text: WatermarkWipe brand name, logo, and website design are our intellectual property. You may not copy, modify, or redistribute our platform without written permission.
